records.Japanese:
交易品を安く買って高く売る
これが交易の基本じゃ
records.previous_English: Buy low, sell high. That is how trade works.
records.english: Buy low, sell high. That's how trading works.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Buying low and selling high is the basis of trade.
records.localization_note: Keep the familiar maxim and give Julio's conversational explanation a full line.

records.Japanese:
地中海とアフリカを往復できるように
なれば、手っ取り早く儲けることが
できるぞい
records.previous_English: Once you can sail between the Mediterranean and Africa, you can turn a quick profit.
records.english: Once you can sail between the Mediterranean and Africa, you can turn a quick profit.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Travel between the Mediterranean and Africa offers quick profits.
records.localization_note: The existing line keeps both regions and the travel prerequisite.

records.Japanese:
まあ、いきなり遠出はムリじゃろう
から、近場で様子を見るのじゃ
records.previous_English: Try trading close to home first. It's a bit early to head that far.
records.english: Try trading close to home first. It's a bit early to head that far.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: A long voyage is unlikely right away, so try trading nearby.
records.localization_note: Keep the advice friendly and make the nearby activity clear.

records.Japanese:
各街の相場を見て
大儲けを狙ってみてもよいぞ
records.previous_English: Check the market prices in each town and look for a chance to make a good profit.
records.english: Check each town's prices. See if you can turn a big profit.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Compare local prices for a chance at larger profits.
records.localization_note: The clean line suggests trying for a large profit. Keep the town-by-town comparison and the invitation to try.
protected_phrases: See if you can turn a big profit.

records.Japanese:
ここ、リスボンでは
サフランかアーモンドを買っておいて
セウタあたりへ売りに行くのが
よいじゃろう
records.previous_English: Here in Lisbon, try buying saffron or almonds and selling them in Ceuta.
records.english: Here in Lisbon, try buying saffron or almonds and selling them in Ceuta.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Buy Lisbon saffron or almonds and sell them around Ceuta.
records.localization_note: Both Lisbon goods and the example sale in Ceuta are clearly stated. Keep the two goods together.

records.Japanese:
最初のうちは、船の数も
積むことのできる船倉も少ないのでな
一度に売り買いできる品数は多くない
records.previous_English: You won't have many ships or cargo holds at first, so you can only trade so much at a time.
records.english: You won't have many ships or cargo holds at first, so you can only trade so much at a time.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Few ships and cargo holds limit early transactions.
records.localization_note: Use conversational advice and keep the limit per transaction.

records.Japanese:
ひとつの積荷倉庫一杯に積む事のできる
量が売買の一単位じゃ。積荷倉庫の数に
応じて買えるというわけじゃな
records.previous_English: One unit of goods fills one cargo hold. The number of holds determines how much you can buy.
records.english: One unit of goods fills one cargo hold. The number of holds determines how much you can buy.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: One trade unit fills one hold, so holds determine purchase capacity.
records.localization_note: The existing wording defines one unit before explaining capacity. Keep the unit's name together.

records.Japanese:
また、『シェア』によっても一度に
扱える数が変わる。無論、『シェア』が
高いほど、たくさん取引できるように
なるぞい
records.previous_English: Market share also affects how much you can trade at once. The greater your share, the more you can trade.
records.english: Market share also affects how much you can trade at once. The greater your share, the more you can trade.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Greater market share allows more trade at once.
records.localization_note: Keep the existing comparison and the term Rafael can ask about. Keep each half of the comparison intact.
protected_phrases: how much you can trade at once.

records.speaker: Choice
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.localization_note: Keep the same term as the lesson and the concise caption.

records.speaker: Choice
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.localization_note: The short natural caption correctly skips the question.

records.Japanese:
シェアって…
どうやって増やすんですか？
records.previous_English: How do we increase our market share?
records.english: How do we increase our market share?
records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Rafael asks how to increase market share.
records.localization_note: The plain beginner question follows the choice.

records.Japanese:
シェアに空きがあるならば
王宮や交易所で投資をした者に分けて
くれる
records.previous_English: If there's any unclaimed market share, you can earn some by investing at the Palace or the Market.
records.english: If there's unclaimed market share, you can earn some by investing at the Palace or the Market.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: If unclaimed share remains, investment at either facility can earn some.
records.localization_note: Preserve the availability condition and both menu labels. Keep the condition's key phrase together.
protected_phrases: at the Palace or the Market.

records.Japanese:
まあ、最初のうちは気にせんでも
よいぞ。ある程度稼いで、船が増えて
からの話じゃからの。とにかく、まずは
交易を試してみることじゃ
records.previous_English: Don't worry about that just yet. It matters once you've made some money and have more ships. First, give trading a try.
records.english: Don't worry about that just yet. It matters once you've made some money and have more ships. First, give trading a try.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Defer worrying about share until the player has earned money and has more ships.
records.localization_note: Keep both reasons to wait and Julio's practical encouragement. The final invitation is a separate thought.
protected_phrases: Don't worry about that just yet.

records.Japanese:
全部よければ、『決定』で
取引終了じゃ
さあ、やってみるのじゃ
records.previous_English: When everything looks right, choose Finish to complete the deal. Now, give it a try.
records.english: When everything looks right, choose Finish to complete the deal. Now, give it a try.
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio teaches Rafael about routes, cargo capacity and market share. Rafael can ask how to increase his share. Julio then returns to the immediate task and sends the player into the Trade screen.
records.source_meaning: Finish completes the deal when the player is ready.
records.localization_note: Keep the exact button label and prompt the player to try it.
